product_title: Royal Peacock Krishna Pearl Toran (38 inches)
product_description: Enhance your home entrance with this elegant handcrafted toran, featuring beautiful peacock motifs, a central Krishna design, intricate golden detailing, and pearl tassels. Perfect for Diwali, pooja rooms, weddings, and traditional home décor.
product_care_suggestion: Gently dust with a soft, dry cloth.
Avoid water, moisture, and direct sunlight.
Handle pearl tassels carefully to prevent tangling.
Store in a dry place in protective packaging after use.
